observed_result.post_run_correction: Added 2026-10-03T00:24Z by the M00-T04 research agent after inspection: a probe defect (macOS ps truncates a non-final comm column, so '/usr/bin/ssh-age' failed the ssh-agent identity check) made setup abort and cleared AGENT_PID, so the script did NOT terminate the dedicated ssh-agent it had started (pid 8361, started 2026-10-02 20:22:26 local; no key had been loaded yet) and then deleted its temp socket directory. The original fields claimed cleanup complete; that was wrong. The orphan was identified by start time, executable (/usr/bin/ssh-agent) and its listening socket path inside the probe's heimdall-g04-lock.* temp namespace, then terminated with a single TERM to that PID; the owner's pre-existing agent (started 2026-09-26) was not touched. Fixed in the probe (comm moved to the last ps column; an unverifiable PID is now kept and reported as residue instead of forgotten). The disposable keychain, caffeinate and temp dir were cleaned by the script as recorded.

limitations: Failed attempt caused by a probe defect; superseded by tests/evidence/g04-macos-lock-probe-smoke-20261003T002454Z.json. Kept for evidence discipline.

Measures a dedicated, script-started OpenSSH ssh-agent and a disposable file-based custom keychain only. Says nothing about the login keychain, the data-protection keychain, Secure Enclave/CTK keys, 1Password, or a launchd-supervised Heimdall signer.
Screen lock only. Logout, sleep, reboot and headless operation are separate probes (docs/research/g04-managed-credentials.md).
ioreg IOConsoleLocked / CGSSessionScreenIsLocked are undocumented IORegistry properties used only as corroboration; owner attestation is recorded separately.
The disposable keychain has auto-lock disabled (no timeout, no lock-on-sleep), so any lock observed is attributable to OS behavior at screen lock, not to keychain settings.
On macOS 26.4+ a keychain file may reference a protected entropy file in /var/db/SystemKeys (Apple TN3137); whether delete-keychain removes it cannot be inspected without disabling SIP.

Status verified means the measurement is valid (lock window established, cleanup complete, no canary in artifacts). Availability itself is reported in observed_result.outcomes_in_window and may be negative.
